name: Milkweed
source:
This is probably the worst ending to a date you can think of. She attacked you, buried you in the middle of nowhere, and now you're really craving blood.

Dating should NOT be this hard.

Play as Ivy, a girlfailure who just went on her first date with another girl. Curse out your vampire blind date. Resist the urge to kill the girl who digs you out of the dirt. Try not to be too much of a loser.

[From [url=https://moomfim.itch.io/milkweed]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这可能是你能想到的最糟糕的约会结局。她袭击了你，把你埋在荒无人烟的地方，而现在你真的很渴望鲜血。

约会不应该这么难。

扮演艾薇，一个刚刚和另一个女孩第一次约会的失败女孩。诅咒你的吸血鬼相亲对象。克制住杀死那个把你从泥土中挖出来的女孩的冲动。尽量不要成为一个失败者。

[来自[url=https://moomfim.itch.io/milkweed]itch.io[/url]]
